sub_parameters.name: DataSource
sub_parameters.description: The information about the associated data source.

sub_parameters.name: Priority
sub_parameters.description:
The priority of the instance. Valid values: 1, 3, 5, 7, and 8.

A larger value indicates a higher priority. Default value: 1.

sub_parameters.name: RuntimeResource
sub_parameters.description: The resource group information. Set this parameter to the ID of a resource group for scheduling.
